input: Any commit that modifies /moves/<agent>.text must be co-signed by at least twelve of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, and that commit must also modify /turn/ply.num, so that a lone off-plan move from panic, greed, or amnesia by any agent, including pawn_g7, can never be accepted.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false)
